method: Computed foreground and ancestor-composited background. Opaque samples with no uncertainty are verified calculations; gradients, group opacity and root estimates are candidates requiring painted sampling. Hidden elements excluded in targeted states. Disabled and color emoji excluded from findings. Normal text 4.5:1; large text 3:1. Samples are not a complete accessibility certification.
